QuestInfo.name: Keeny the Genius
QuestInfo.0: Keeny has started learning alchemy in earnest. Go check how Keeny is doing.
QuestInfo.1: Keeny says that she has completed the Pentacle Design for Dr. De Lang and she wants you to draw the #bPentacle#k as shown in the design. You don't know if the designs are right.
QuestInfo.2: You complete the pentacle according to the designs provided by Keeny. Surprisingly she tells you that it is completely correct.

0.0: My dad's always been busy, but now I hardly see him. That's why my mom's been unhappy. She claims he duped her into marriage.
0.1: So I want to help Dad. He was having trouble with the pentacle in his laboratory, so I finished one for him instead. Why don't you take a look?

yes.0: I double-checked the calculations. I don't think anything was wrong, so complete the #bpentacle#k like this. You'll probably need to draw it at least #r3#k times, since it's pretty complicated.

1.0: You drew that pentacle using Keeny's blueprint? You just trusted a child?! Do you realize how much work I've put into the pentacle? Sigh... I'd better start from scratch.

yes.0: ...Wow, this pentacle is flawless! Keeny really drew this? Who would've thought that a child could know so much.. My daughter must be a prodigy!

default.0: How long has it been since I've been home? A week, maybe?

npc.0: Draw the pentacle exactly as you see on the blueprint. Exactly!
